description: Auditable multilingual judgment dataset that is the companion to the frozen jev-judgments dataset. It supplies labelled samples for the seven Jev decision definitions that carried zero samples there — extraction.field_grounded.v1, evidence.consistency.v1, entity.relation.v1, teaching.capability.v1, tool.intent.v1, feedback.category.v1 and feedback.severity.v1 — so their module/component ablation arms no longer report INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLES. Labels carry a tier (OBJECTIVE_VERIFIED / SOURCE_REVIEWED / DISPUTED) with evidence; SILVER_DEEPSEEK is deliberately absent because no model was called. Negative and edge cases (wrong-field extraction, contradictions, non-authorised writes, blocking defects) are over-represented so the calibration cannot be gamed by an always-positive predictor.

label_tier_definitions.OBJECTIVE_VERIFIED: Verified by code (rule / id / sum / arithmetic).
label_tier_definitions.SOURCE_REVIEWED: Cites a course source with a locator and review reason.
label_tier_definitions.SILVER_DEEPSEEK: Unreviewed DeepSeek suggestion; NOT human gold.

precision_note: The Jev SDK reports probabilities rounded to 4 decimal places at the service boundary; calibration must use the highest-precision values available.

label_tier_scope_note: Tier semantics on this companion dataset, stated explicitly so the tier is not read more strongly than it is. OBJECTIVE_VERIFIED means a deterministic rule that already exists in the repository computes this exact label (each label_evidence names the rule and its file); it is a code-verified baseline, not human gold. SOURCE_REVIEWED means a reviewer read the case against the supplied evidence and recorded a reason: for extraction / evidence-consistency / entity-relation / capability samples that evidence is course material with a locator (a file, a question, a section or a step), while for tool.intent.v1 and feedback.* the state IS a user turn or a user report by construction, so there the reviewed source is the supplied user_message / tool arguments / report_text rather than course material. DISPUTED records both readings with the recorded one named. No SILVER_DEEPSEEK sample exists here because no model was called when authoring this file.
